subject: PO routing + entity/VAT mapping for FinServe supplier registration
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finserve.it>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@finserve.it
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 15:12:00 +0200
Subject: Vendor enrollment - PO and VAT mapping questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Our AP team asked me to follow up with a couple of clarifications so we can create Redwood as a vendor in FinServe's supplier system and ensure POs route correctly. Two quick items: 

1) PO number format: our platform requires a customer PO with a 3-letter prefix for internal routing (example: FIN-2028-000123). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept POs that start with FIN- and still map to the right billing ledger?

2) Legal entity mapping: we need the registered legal name and the VAT ID for the legal entity that will appear on invoices. Our system supports separate remit and invoice entities; please indicate the primary invoice entity.

Attached is our preferred PO template (FinServe_PO_Format_v1.pdf) — no need to reformat if you can provide the invoice with the fields highlighted (PO number, invoice number, invoice date, tax amount, bank remit details).

If possible, can you send the VAT certificate or a self-attestation so AP can fast-track our supplier activation?

Best,
Elena Rossi
AP Operations — FinServe S.p.A.
elena.rossi@finserve.it
+39 02 1234 5678

Attachment: FinServe_PO_Format_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finserve.it>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:43:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment - PO and VAT mapping questions

Hi Elena — thanks, and great to meet yesterday.

Short answers up front:
- PO prefix: yes, we can accept FIN- prefixed POs. Our billing pipeline will map customer PO prefixes to the FinServe ledger if the PO field arrives in the invoice metadata. We'll add a validation rule so FIN- prefixed POs go to the FinServe account in our system.
- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) is our invoicing entity for most customers. For EU customers who require an EU-registered supplier, we can invoice via Redwood EU SARL — VAT ID BE0123456789. 

I've attached a brief onboarding checklist and our preferred invoice field mapping. Also including the VAT certificate (attached) and a sample invoice with the FIN- prefix to validate with your parser.

Next steps:
1) Elena — can you confirm whether FinServe will use self-billing or expects standard supplier invoices?
2) Ben — can you confirm whether Finance is okay with separate remit and invoice entity mapping (Redwood Inference, Inc. / Redwood EU SARL)?
3) Marissa — I'll loop CS to confirm delivery address and PO acknowledgement behavior during contract activation.

Thanks — I put the attachments together for AP.

— Kimberly Park
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf; Redwood_VAT_cert_EU.jpg; sample_invoice_FIN-000123.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment - PO and VAT mapping questions

Kimberly,

Confirmed — Finance is okay with mapping separate remit vs invoice entities for this account provided: 
- The PO lands with a FIN- prefix and a canonical FinServe account id in the PO metadata (we'll ask for your internal supplier id).
- Invoices include the VAT breakdown line and a clear remit-to bank account (we will not accept an invoice without the VAT line populated for EU entities).
- Any credit notes reference the original invoice number and PO.

I recommend we ask FinServe to include the internal supplier ID in the PO (custom field) so our ingestion is deterministic. If they cannot, we'll implement prefix routing for a trial period and validate over the first three invoices.

Ben Carter
Finance Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Finance_PO_Mapping_GUIDE.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finserve.it>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment - PO and VAT mapping questions

Hi Elena — looping in CS to confirm operational behavior. A couple of clarifications from implementation:
- PO acknowledgement: Redwood will send an automated PO acknowledgement when the PO is first ingested. That acknowledgement contains the mapped ledger, expected invoice email (invoices@redwoodinference.com), and the assigned supplier reference.
- If FinServe uses self-billing, we need a signed self-billing agreement. Otherwise, please send invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com with the FIN- prefixed PO in the PO field.

Elena — attaching the onboarding CSV template we use to provision suppliers into FinServe's system (so you can confirm required columns).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: supplier_provisioning_template.csv

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finserve.it>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jun 2028 16:23:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment - PO and VAT mapping questions

> - PO acknowledgement: Redwood will send an automated PO acknowledgement when the PO is first ingested. That acknowledgement contains the mapped ledger, expected invoice email (invoices@redwoodinference.com), and the assigned supplier reference.
> - If FinServe uses self-billing, we need a signed self-billing agreement. Otherwise, please send invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com with the FIN- prefixed PO in the PO field.

Hi Kimberly and Marissa — thanks for the clear notes. FinServe will not be using self-billing for the pilot; AP will issue standard POs. We attached the supplier provisioning CSV and the VAT certificate for Redwood EU SARL. 

We have filled the supplier CSV and included:
- supplier_internal_id: FS-RED-482
- invoice_entity: Redwood EU SARL
- VAT ID: BE0123456789
- remit_bank: IT98X0542811101000000123456 (BIC: FINSVIT2)

Attachments submitted: FinServe_PO_Format_v1.pdf; FinServe_VAT_certificate_2027.jpg; supplier_provisioning_csv_filled.csv

Please confirm once Redwood is active in the FinServe supplier master and let us know the supplier_reference you assign.

Regards,
Elena Rossi
AP Operations — FinServe S.p.A.
Attachment: FinServe_VAT_certificate_2027.jpg (image); supplier_provisioning_csv_filled.csv (csv)
